skill_outcomes.skill_name: Understanding characteristics and role of water resources
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Students understand the basic characteristics and roles of water resources.

skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Students understand the economics of public water supply and domestic water use.
Students understand the economics of irrigation water supply.
Students understand the economics of hydropower energy.

skill_outcomes.skill_name: Flood prevention and coastal protection economics
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Students understand the economics of flood prevention and coastal protection.
Students understand government management of water resources.

skill_outcomes.skill_name: Summarizing and generalizing water resource issues
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Students develop skills to summarize and generalize water resource issues.

skill_outcomes.skill_name: Planning and managing resources for independent and group activities
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Students develop planning and management skills for independent and group activities.

skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Students develop social responsibility and professional ethics in making judgments and evaluations about specialized issues.

skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Students develop recognition and adherence to legal regulations regarding water resource management and products.
